applies_to: all subsequent Barnase--Barstar arc-length-500 diagnostics in this campaign
decision_timing: after all three alpha-confirmation optimization trajectories were sealed and before evaluating the new alpha=10 N_F=716 path

allowed_only_if_all_match: grid s_j = j L / 499 including both endpoints
canonical OpenMM CPU/double energy oracle and force-request count zero
source diagnostic output and audit SHA-256 with PASS status
source row contains exactly 500 successful energy evaluations and no failed energy evaluation
exact_reuse_rule.forbidden: parameter-based, metric-based, approximate-coordinate, interpolated-energy, or cross-oracle reuse
exact_reuse_rule.new_path_rule: a path hash absent from the audited source must receive 500 fresh energy-only evaluations
exact_reuse_rule.reporting: record source diagnostic row and hashes per reused path; report newly executed and lineage-bound diagnostic energy counts separately

metric_policy_interpretation: This supersedes diagnostic_cache=false only for exact, hash-identical path/grid/oracle reuse. It does not change either metric definition and applies symmetrically to every method and parameter setting.
